name: Going To Court
overview: Scripture teaches that believers should approach conflicts and legal disputes with wisdom and a heart pleasing to the Lord, which can even bring peace with adversaries. Proverbs warns against rushing into strife without understanding the consequences, while Isaiah assures that no weapon or accusation formed against God's servants will ultimately succeed. Jesus emphasizes reconciliation and addressing offenses privately before escalating matters, underscoring the importance of humility and seeking peace rather than contention in judgment.
